name: Looking for a Title
source:
A recreation of the first chapter of the webcomic "Looking for a Title," in which the majority of the characters are introduced. Due to it being the very beginning of the series, it's fairly short and straightforward, featuring 9 explorable locations.

[Edited from [url=http://quasicake.net/extra/VNch1.html]Quasi Cake[/url]]
translation:
本作重现了网络漫画《寻找标题》的第一章，大部分角色会在这一章登场。由于只是系列的开端，故事相当短小、直接，共有九个可探索的地点。

（根据[url=http://quasicake.net/extra/VNch1.html]Quasi Cake[/url]编辑。）
